# biocroxytest <a href="https://xec-cm.github.io/biocroxytest/"><img src="man/figures/logo.png" align="right" height="138" alt="biocroxytest logo" /></a>

<!-- badges: start -->
[![Bioconductor](https://img.shields.io/badge/Bioconductor-biocroxytest-blue)](https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/biocroxytest.html)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/xec-cm/biocroxytest/workflows/R-CMD-check-bioc/badge.svg)](https://github.com/xec-cm/biocroxytest/actions)
<!-- badges: end -->

Write testthat assertions next to the R code they cover. biocroxytest uses
roxygen2 to generate test files and helps keep Bioconductor long tests in a
separate suite. The test-generation workflow builds on
[roxytest](https://github.com/mikldk/roxytest).

## Installation

### GitHub development build

This site documents the [GitHub devel branch](https://github.com/xec-cm/biocroxytest/tree/devel).
Install it for the unified test roclet, named cases, fixtures, replay and
paired-data reduction.

```{r install-github, eval=FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}
if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) {
  BiocManager::install("remotes")
}
BiocManager::install("xec-cm/biocroxytest@devel", update = FALSE)
```

### Bioconductor release

biocroxytest has been available through Bioconductor since 3.19. Install the
release compatible with your R version using BiocManager.

```{r install-bioc, eval=FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}
BiocManager::install("biocroxytest")
```

See the [Bioconductor package page](https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/biocroxytest.html)
and [release vignette](https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/vignettes/biocroxytest/inst/doc/biocroxytest.html)
for documentation of that build.

## Get started

With the GitHub development build, install `testthat` and add it to
`Suggests`. Set up the suites you use from your package root with
`usethis::use_testthat()` for ordinary tests and
`biocroxytest::use_longtests()` for long tests. Install `usethis` if you
use the ordinary setup. Add the unified roclet to your existing roxygen
configuration in `DESCRIPTION`.

```text
Roxygen: list(roclets = c("namespace", "rd", "biocroxytest::tests_roclet"))
```

Add assertions to a roxygen block in `R/`.

```{r first-test, eval=FALSE}
#' Increment an integer
#'
#' @param x An integer vector.
#' @return An integer vector.
#' @export
#' @tests
#' expect_identical(increment(2L), 3L)
increment <- function(x) x + 1L
```

Run `roxygen2::roxygenise()` from the package root and commit the generated
files. Ordinary tests live in `tests/testthat/`. Tests declared with
`@longtests` live in `longtests/testthat/`.

- [Generate and run tests](https://xec-cm.github.io/biocroxytest/articles/biocroxytest.html)
- [Manage named cases, fixtures and failures](https://xec-cm.github.io/biocroxytest/articles/named-cases.html)
- [Function reference](https://xec-cm.github.io/biocroxytest/reference/index.html)
